create.name: Shakti Durga
create.bio:
Shakti Durga, who earlier taught under her birth name Kim Fraser, is the founder and spiritual director of Shanti Mission, a meditation and devotional community in Australia with groups in the UK, the United States and India. She came to spiritual practice in the 1990s while working as a lawyer and raising a family after a divorce, and went on to train in meditation, personal development and energy healing under several teachers. She teaches in an Eastern devotional style, and shaktipat blessings are part of Shanti Mission's festival intensives.

Her teaching blends Indian mantra, kirtan and goddess worship with Western mystical traditions, and centres on practical ways to bring more peace into relationships, work and daily life. She has written five books, including Spiritual Mastery and Ignite Your Spirit, and her Path of Ease and Grace seminars are built on them. She leads intensives, fire ceremonies and festival programmes at the Harmony Centre near Cooranbong in New South Wales, where she lives with her husband, and holds retreats abroad. Shanti Mission also runs weekly satsang, meditation sessions and an online channelled teaching series she has led since 2020.

books.title: Spiritual Mastery: Twelve Hallmarks of Spiritual Mastery
books.author: Shakti Durga
books.description: Shakti Durga sets out twelve qualities she sees in people who have matured on the spiritual path, with reflections and practices for growing into each. Published in 2020 by her own imprint, Higher Guidance.

books.title: Ignite Your Spirit: Energy Healing - Realise Your Highest Potential
books.author: Shakti Durga
books.description: Her guide to the energy-healing system she teaches, with explanations of the subtle body and exercises for clearing and strengthening one's own energy. It was first published under the name Kim Fraser.

courses.title: The Solar Gateway Spiritual Intensive with Shakti Durga
courses.description: Three summer-solstice mornings of fire ceremony, initiation and teaching with Shakti Durga at the Harmony Centre in Cooranbong or online. Each day turns to a different aspect of the Divine Mother: Durga, Saraswati and Maha Lakshmi.

courses.title: Satsang at Shanti Mission
courses.description: Shanti Mission's weekly Sunday gathering at the Harmony Centre, open to anyone. It brings together song, a short teaching, guided meditation and a group blessing from long-standing practitioners.
